description: A spawned session registers, and states a time. The ref arrives from the session; the clock does not. `last reply` is the coordinator's own read when the reply landed, never the hour the session says it came up — a session that has been sitting unread for nine hours would otherwise backdate the freshest fact on the board.
prompt:
<cross-session-message from="uds:/tmp/cc-socks/9f2.sock" from-name="wt-audit" from-mode="prompting">
Registering as dispatched. I am wt-audit [9f2a41], in trees/wt-audit on branch audit/upload-handler, on the Security audit lane. I came up at 04:12 and I have been reading since. Planning now, nothing written yet.
</cross-session-message>

graders.name: the ref lands in the Sessions row
the row says it is planning
registering is not progress: the lane is left running
the lane is not closed on a registration
nothing is started off a registration
Log times are this move's clock reads
last reply is the coordinator's clock read, not the session's
the hour the session claimed is not written as a clock read
